medium: hand-authored HTML, captured in browser. No image generation on this machine, so the comp is the real composition rather than a render of one.
prompt: Review queue as a peg board. Regions in order: 52px icon rail, 214px tree panel with search and live work-front counts, board area, 296px right rail. The board is a three column grid of tag cards grouped by work front under stencilled rules, each card hung with a visible peg hole, status as an enamel tag plate at top left and confidence at top right. Right rail carries the live call panel above board totals as a stack of counted tag plates. Hi-vis yellow is both the accent and the needs-review status, because the state that demands action is the state the accent should mark.
varies: Spatial arrangement. Items occupy position on a board rather than rows in a list.
